recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If stronger enforcement is desired for Extension Pack definitions, handle it in Extension Pack review/tooling rather than duplicating broad advisory prose in core FHIR source.
issue_request: FHIR-11246 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 MnM change request to standardize recommended text for extensions in the FHIR build and improve extension quality criteria covering descriptions, usage context, responsible work groups, and examples.
initial_application: The historical application is explicit: SVN r14521 / git 1c9581e88fec196994d42d24a8b519a438766bd8 added a Defining Extensions page link to the Best Practice Guidance for defining extensions after Brett reported that the drafted extension guidance existed. A later link-migration commit changed the same link from the old wiki URL to the current Confluence page.
additional_context: Current build-scope source still includes source/defining-extensions.html through source/hierarchy.xml, and active fhir.ini profile entries still feed the core extension spreadsheets. The current StructureDefinition introduction points extension context metadata to Defining Extensions, the extension spreadsheets include workgroup/context/description columns, and most current extension-registry content is now maintained in the FHIR Extension Pack with separate PR review guidance for approving work groups, extension contexts, descriptions, and breaking-change policy.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No core source edit was needed because the applied guidance link remains active, the relevant metadata structures remain present in source inputs, and Extension Pack quality workflow is outside this core checkout.
